# Seed 77 on the AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 8840HS - 12 hours from scratch, every freeze lifted: inside the 10-hour runs' spread; one corpus death, the hole fault, fixed (Iteration 560)

`seed 77 12h then experiment review-checks.py spread then experiment appbench.py --zip ~/Downloads/appbench.zip --sample 16 then experiment clockcheck.py --sample 8` at 45903e43b. The chain: done. 41,308 designs, generations 0-161: 26,519 ok, 9,925 stopped after one round, 4,836 screened, 27 wrong output: apps, 1 died: corpus; 3,442 designs an hour.

**The front**: the true one 370 designs - the report's 370, the same.

**The fixed-box hypervolume**: true front 370 (369 inside the box), hypervolume 0.35010 | fastest 0.1421, smallest 14015, least memory 108 KB, fastest at 32 bits 0.1841. **The stopping rule** (stopping.py, results/stopping-series.md): verdict: seed 77 opens the series - nothing earlier to gain on the count: 1 run(s) on the method; the earliest stop after seed 79, if every run until then gains nothing the next run gains if: the hypervolume >= 0.35360, the fastest <= 0.1378, the smallest <= 13,875, the least memory <= 104 KB, the fastest at 32 bits <= 0.1668

**The extremes**: fastest 0cc2c03ff7 0.1421, smallest 6867871acf 14,015 bytes, least memory 108 KB, fastest at 32 bits 4b12498248 0.1841.

**One round first**: 9,925 children stopped after one round, 27.3% of those measured; 1061 audited in full, 0 of them on the front.

**The operators**: borrowed 39.5%, crossover 24.7%, mutation 35.7% of the children; the last fifth borrowed 40.0%, crossover 22.1%, mutation 37.9%; the front's entries per child 0.899% (370 of 41,170).

**The JIT designs**: 106 of the front, 37 of its fastest tenth's 37; jitmul 64, jitfuse 16, jitexec 1, jitos 73, jitrp 52.

**The fast end re-measured** (remeasure.json, 152 designs): the fastest ten 1.061 re-measured / in-run, the JIT designs 1.047, the rest 0.992.

**The experiments**: the spread at generation 128 - | build/evolve/db.jsonl | 128 | 21292 | 423 | 0.1418 | 14,051 | 108 | 9.5336e+05 | 0.6444 | 0.1826 |; appbench - **Spearman, in-run speed against the applications' geometric mean: 0.903 over 16 designs.**; the clock test - **Medians** - time against the run: alone 1.061, beside benchmarks 1.037, beside compiles 1.032; time against alone: benchmarks 0.994, compiles 0.990; cycles against alone: benchmarks 0.997, compiles 1.002.; truefronts - none.

**The remote checks** (results/xcheck-seed77.md): dream.lan-prebuilt 24 designs measured on both: Spearman 0.957; dream.lan-prebuilt32 30 designs measured on both: Spearman 0.951; dream.lan-prebuilt64 30 designs measured on both: Spearman 0.968; rage.lan-native 16 designs measured on both: Spearman 0.921.

**The verdict** (rule 1): no comparison step in the chain - the run against seeds 73-76 by the spread at generation 128 (session 64), each run's records to the same generation: inside their spread - the fastest 0.1418 against 0.1379-0.1389 (the slowest of five, 2.8% behind), the smallest 14,051 (the best of five), the least memory 108 KB as all five; the lifted freezes bought nothing at equal effort. **The stopping rule** (stopping.py): seed 77 opens the 12-hour series - and is its only run: seed 78 runs 9 hours (the owner, 560), a new series, the count restarts.

**Prediction 555** (twelve hours do not beat the 10-hour bar - on the tolerance front, hv.py's line, as the checklist says): **fails, by the least memory alone** - 108 KB against seeds 74-76's 112, the 4 KB threshold met exactly (one page); the hypervolume 0.35010 (the bar 0.36024), the fastest 0.1421 (0.1336), the smallest 14,015 (13,938), the fastest at 32 bits 0.1841 (0.1688) hold. Not the hours: seed 76's alive designs reached 108 KB already (its dominance chain hid them - 556), and the spread finds every run at 108 KB by generation 128. **Prediction 556** (the freezes were right): **holds** - lifted.py: bytehdr, doesfar, thinhdr, varcall, bss, lean at 1 and msc, scale, sharedcall, alignhot at 0 on 100% of the true front (370); the other values' enrichment 0.00.

**The deaths**: one died on the corpus - 0b17df4e1c (generation 122, mutation jitexec=1; jit, tracer and nocrossjump: the 557 hole pair). deaths-check.py rebuilt it here: its corpus DIFFERS from s6's on the tree before the fix (4256111, the control) and is s6's on the fixed tree (c6eea5d) - the fault the after-seed-77 batch fixed; no correctness issue open. 27 wrong on apps, every one cpt16 (516's: it stops early on the applications' undefined words - expected); 24 failures at 32 bits, every one cpt16's reach (517).

**Held out** (heldout.py): sieve's Spearman 0.955 over 370 (seeds 49-57 about 0.94); the fastest third 0.854, the fastest tenth 0.698; the regret 13.3% (the selection's fastest 0cc2c03ff7 0.068 held out, the held-out fastest ce3cd13f29 0.060). **The curse** (rule 3, ATTENTION): the fastest tenth re-measured / in-run 1.054 (1.024-1.132), as seeds 73-76 (1.070, 1.066, 1.047, 1.063) - the offset, item 4. **The clock test's cost both pay**: 464-831 us by workload alone (bubble 498, kernel 726), past seed 75's shifts (bubble about 300, kernel 75) - a cost that large can carry the offset; compiles beside move the ratio -1.0%, not the cause. **appbench**: Spearman 0.903 over 16; the fastest, 44aaae552d, 0.421 of s6 on the applications.

**Progress**: the speed's last 2% gain at generation 67 of 161, the smallest's last at 135 (2 gains in the last third, 36 bytes) - the 12 hours' last 94 generations moved the fast end by less than 2%. **The votes**: all four removal votes for scale, sharedcall, msc, alignhot, factor; over seeds 75-77 no candidate. **The rules**: 3 (the curse) and 8 (tail - retired, its code removed: nothing to do) ATTENTION, the rest PASS; 10 PASS by run-tests below.

**The chain on master** (process-checks.sh at c6eea5d, the after-seed-77 batch applied): build 0, run-tests PASS, validate 7 of 7 IDENTICAL, the gate alive 417 of 417, ans-check 0 of 96 differ (its negative control caught), deaths-check 1 of 1 right, the jail PASS.
